name: Vaultwarden
summary: Every password, on every device, in a vault only you hold the key to.

catalog.description: Vaultwarden lets you use the familiar Bitwarden apps with your own private backend for passwords, secure notes, cards, identities, and shared vaults.

features.title: Use Bitwarden clients
features.body: Connect browser extensions, mobile apps, desktop apps, and the web vault to your own server.

features.title: Keep vault data encrypted
features.body: Vault data is encrypted by the client before it reaches the server, so the server stores encrypted vault data.

features.title: Share with family or a team
features.body: Use Bitwarden-compatible organization and collection features for shared credentials when you need them.

resourceHint.label: Light resources
resourceHint.description: This MOS package runs Vaultwarden as one service using its built-in SQLite storage.

privacy.summary: Vaultwarden runs entirely on your own server with no telemetry, storing client-encrypted vault data locally, while your master password remains your responsibility.
notes: Use a strong, unique master password.
Keep backups, because losing the app data volume can mean losing the vault.
By default the server fetches website icons from the sites you save, which can reveal those domains to third parties; you can turn icon downloading off in Vaultwarden if you prefer.

homepage.name: Vaultwarden
homepage.description: Keep passwords and secure notes on your own server.

sections.title: Create the first Vaultwarden account
sections.body: Open Vaultwarden over its generated app URL and create the owner account before storing shared credentials.

sections.title: Admin token generated
sections.body: MOS generates a strong admin token for the Vaultwarden admin panel and stores only a secret reference plus fingerprint in Suite Manager state. This slice does not yet include an owner-facing reveal or rotation flow.
